posts.author: JohnFP
posts.content_md:
Wow.......choke, sniff sniff, cough... 

I want to thank you all for your support during the difficult times!!! I have truly made some cherished friends here. It’s amazingly great to be part of this community.

I didn't even know there were landmarks for the number of posts. I surely never posted here to get any recognition and sometimes I was reluctant to post because there are much more experienced and knowledgeable persons herein. And I didn't want it to seem like I was hogging the forum. But I love to talk holography, and I am finding out I love to help others understand something. Sometime in helping others understand they guide me down a road of new understanding. I have been telling my wife for about two years now that I would LOVE to be a teacher, any kind really, well any math or science teacher. When my children are grown and self supportive and I can relax on the monetary income focus, I truly believe I will retire to become a teacher of some sort. Even if it is elementary Math or Science.

With that, I would like as a birthday present…for other to try, just try to post more. It's so great hearing others opinions/knowledge on subjects. And I would like to thank all who participate here.

So anyway, thanks again and health, peace ad prosperity be with you all!
